title: BBC Learning English from the News 2024 — Quiz 8
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q71_silent_threat
elements.title: Why might an invisible gas leak be called a silent threat?
choices: It only poses a danger during the day.
It can be detected by its loud noise.
It poses a danger people may not notice.
It becomes harmless when it cannot be heard.
elements.correctAnswer: It poses a danger people may not notice.

elements.name: q72_leapfrog
elements.title: Two wins helped the team leapfrog its closest rival in the rankings. What happened?
choices: Both teams were removed from the rankings.
The rival moved ahead of the team.
The team stayed tied with its rival.
The team moved ahead of its rival.
elements.correctAnswer: The team moved ahead of its rival.

elements.name: q73_immunity
elements.title: “The law grants witnesses immunity from prosecution in certain cases.” What does “immunity” mean here?
choices: A guarantee that testimony stays secret
Legal protection from being prosecuted
An obligation to give evidence
The right to prosecute someone else

elements.name: q74_blueprint
elements.title: The report offers a blueprint for improving bus services. What does it offer?
choices: A list of complaints without proposals
A record of every bus trip
A ticket covering all bus routes
A plan for achieving the improvement
elements.correctAnswer: A plan for achieving the improvement

elements.name: q75_relish
elements.title: “I relish the chance to work with this team.” How does the speaker feel about the opportunity?
choices: They are unaware of it.
They doubt that it exists.
They would rather avoid it.
They welcome and enjoy it.

elements.name: q76_strikes_a_deal
elements.title: The publisher strikes a deal with a new distributor. What happens?
choices: The publisher rejects the distributor's proposal.
The distributor breaks an earlier agreement.
They end their negotiations without agreement.
They reach an agreement.

elements.name: q77_dumps
elements.title: In a report about data, what are “dumps” of leaked files?
choices: Small corrections to public records
Large batches of digital files released together
Files stored only on damaged devices
Lists of passwords that were changed
elements.correctAnswer: Large batches of digital files released together

elements.name: q78_twists_and_turns
elements.title: The case took many twists and turns before it was settled. What happened along the way?
choices: The same decision was made each time.
All events followed the original plan.
There were several unexpected developments.
The case was settled at the first hearing.

elements.name: q79_two_fingers
elements.title: In British usage, what does “giving someone two fingers” usually describe?
choices: Asking someone to repeat themselves
Making a rude gesture
Using a hand signal to say hello
Offering to carry something

elements.name: q80_bromance
elements.title: A reviewer describes a film as “a bromance between two old friends”. What is the film likely to focus on?
choices: A feud between two families
A romance between former classmates
A close friendship between two men
A rivalry between two brothers
elements.correctAnswer: A close friendship between two men
